root: ^Is it all right if I tell you something.. unpleasant?

^When you first walked through my door I just thought I was looking at a run of the mill commoner without a coin to their name. But it turns out you are actually quite a capable individual. And you’ve been the best customer I've had in years.
^Makes me real happy knowing my family was wrong about this business after all.
^Ehem, forget I said that. Anyways I must humbly thank you.
^But good gods please do get a change of clothes sometime.
